newsitem.title: UK: Jardine Lloyd to acquire stake in Traveltest.
newsitem.headline: Jardine Lloyd to acquire stake in Traveltest.

text.p: Insurance brokerage group Jardine Lloyd Thompson Group Plc said on Thursday that it would acquire the entire share capital in Traveltest, a firm specialising in shipowner protection in which it already held 76 percent.
Jardine Lloyd had earlier held the stake through Lloyd Thompson Group which merged with JIB Group Plc to form Jardine Lloyd.
Jardine Lloyd also inherited a 12 percent stake in the Traveltest's non-voting share capital.
The group would now acquire all the capital for a consideration of 8.66 million stg consisting of issue of new 3.99 million shares in Jardine Lloyd and 1.11 million stg in cash.
